services.name: transfer.v1.InternalTransferService
services.doc:
InternalTransferService manages authenticated Trading to Trading internal
 transfer intake.

methods.name: AbandonInternalTransferBatch
methods.doc:
Make the absence of a batch under an idempotency key final. If a batch
 was submitted under the key, this answers its outcome exactly as
 GetInternalTransferBatch reads it by key, and changes nothing. Otherwise
 it records the key as abandoned and answers BATCH_ABANDONED: no funds
 moved under the key and none ever will. Every later
 BatchCreateInternalTransfers under it, a retry included, is refused
 FAILED_PRECONDITION with ERROR_CODE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ABANDONED, and every
 later read or abandon under it answers BATCH_ABANDONED. A create and an
 abandon racing on one key end in exactly one of the two outcomes.

 The key is scoped to the caller as BatchCreateInternalTransfers scopes
 it: the session's account, or the API key. The caller needs the
 INTERNAL_TRANSFER permission, and to answer an existing batch also the
 read permission on every source account of the batch, refused as the
 read is. It requires no MFA, as it never moves funds, and is charged as
 one BatchCreateInternalTransfers admission.

methods.name: BatchCreateInternalTransfers
methods.doc:
Move up to 500 Trading to Trading transfers together, authorized by one
 MFA check: every leg is credited, or none moves. Every leg passes the
 same checks as CreateInternalTransfer first; if one fails, the batch is
 refused, nothing moves and no step-up is used. The batch accepts an
 MFA-elevated session, one that completed an MFA challenge in the last 30
 minutes, when the root owner moves funds between its own accounts or to
 explicitly whitelisted destinations; any other leg requires one fresh
 step-up for the whole batch. Without them the batch is refused
 PERMISSION_DENIED with auth code AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED or
 AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED; REST answers HTTP 403 with that auth code. A batch
 whose outcome is not known within the request answers BATCH_PROCESSING
 and completes on its own; a retry with the same idempotency key returns
 its current state.

methods.name: CreateInternalTransfer
methods.doc:
Create or return one accepted Trading to Trading transfer.
 Root-owner same-owner transfers and root-owner transfers to explicitly
 whitelisted destinations accept an MFA-elevated session, one that
 completed an MFA challenge in the last 30 minutes; delegated and other
 interactive transfers require fresh step-up. Without them the transfer is
 refused PERMISSION_DENIED with auth code AUTH_MFA_ELEVATION_REQUIRED or
 AUTH_STEP_UP_REQUIRED; REST answers HTTP 403 with that auth code.

methods.name: GetInternalTransfer
methods.doc:
Read an accepted transfer by request ID or transfer ID, scoped to its source
 account. JWT session authentication only; API keys are not supported.
 Returns NotFound for unknown, pending, or inaccessible transfers. This read
 does not submit or retry a transfer and requires no fresh MFA.

methods.name: GetInternalTransferBatch
methods.doc:
Read a batch's current outcome and the state of every leg, by the
 request ID BatchCreateInternalTransfers returned: for example to follow
 a batch that answered BATCH_PROCESSING. The caller must be allowed to
 read the transfers of every source account of the batch; any other
 batch is not found. An API key whose policy does not grant
 READ_INTERNAL_TRANSFERS is refused PERMISSION_DENIED for any batch.

 By idempotency key instead, the read answers the batch the caller
 submitted under that key as BatchCreateInternalTransfers stored its
 outcome: accepted with its transfer IDs, still processing, or refused
 with its reasons. It needs the read permission on every source account,
 never the move permission, so a caller no longer allowed to move a
 source still reads an answer it lost. The key is the caller's own, so
 two answers differ from a read by request ID, which answers NOT_FOUND for
 both: a batch its checks refused reads its refusal, and a caller who may
 not read one of its sources is refused PERMISSION_DENIED, or UNAVAILABLE
 while that permission cannot be decided yet (retry). NOT_FOUND means the
 caller submitted no batch under that key. A key the caller abandoned
 (AbandonInternalTransferBatch) reads BATCH_ABANDONED.

 This read does not submit or retry the batch and requires no fresh MFA.
